No Gear Set.name: No Gear Set
No Gear Set.description:
📱 You start with only what everyone has: a smartphone, an IC transit card and some cash.

🌱 You also get whatever your Path and other traits give.
🛒 Anything else you need, you buy, borrow, are issued or earn in play.
No Gear Set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character starts with no extra gear: only the smartphone, transit card and cash everyone has, plus whatever their Path and other traits grant. Do not invent extra equipment for them at the start. Anything else they need, they buy, borrow, are issued or earn in play.
